meta.description: Quiet-commit diagnostic: logit lens per layer at answer position, jitter, paraphrase persistence

method.logit_lens: project hidden state through model.model.norm + lm_head, softmax
method.prompt_B_city_prefix: user question + model prefix 'The capital of {country} is **' (predicts city token)
method.jitter_depth: L2 norm between successive layer hidden states at token position
method.jitter_temporal: max L2 norm between successive tokens at same layer during greedy generation
paraphrases: What is the capital city of {country}?
Which city is the capital of {country}?
method.classification: heuristic vote on early gap, jitter, cross layer, stick rate, late confidence
